# Is your crossed-out price allowed?

> Free EU 30-day lowest price checker for webshops: paste a price history and see the prior price you may show next to a sale, the true percentage off, and whether your crossed-out price or advertised discount holds up. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
